name: Reap and Sow
storyline: After dealing with a crippling first quarter, the idea of a social life was out the window. That was until Julio and Lauren stepped in, having invited you to the biggest party of the quarter! Although, Things take an unexpected turn when they convince you to summon an ancient lust demon, whom seems to take a strange liking to you.
summary: After being invited to the biggest house party of the year, things take an unexpected turn when you summon an ancient lust demon. Navigate a bustling house party, attempting to lure unknowing party guests as sacrifices to your new god. Who knows, maybe if you do good they'll keep you?
